traits.capitulum_kind.note: FNA vol. 19, genus Cichorium: florets all ligulate (tribe Cichorieae), 8-25+ a head.

traits.involucre_diameter_m.note: FNA vol. 19, genus Cichorium: involucres more or less cylindric, 3-5+ mm in diameter.

traits.phyllary_series.note: FNA vol. 19, genus Cichorium: phyllaries 10-15+ in 2+ series.

traits.pappus.note: FNA vol. 19, Cichorium intybus: pappi 0.01-0.2 mm, a minute crown of scales.

traits.rosette.note: FNA vol. 19, Cichorium: basal leaves, the cauline ones smaller and narrower upward.

traits.woodiness.note: FNA vol. 19, genus Cichorium: annuals, biennials or perennials, herbs.
